items.name: Snorkelling
items.description: Snorkel from the beach over coral and seagrass. The safest spot is between the flags. Go at high tide, when entry is easier.

items.name: Glass-bottom boat
items.description: See the reef without getting wet. The world's first glass-bottom boat launched here in 1937.

items.name: Marine biologist guided snorkel
items.description: Snorkel with a marine biologist who points out corals, fish and turtles.

items.name: Scuba diving
items.description: Introductory and certified dives, booked through the Dive Centre.

items.name: Seawalker helmet diving
items.description: Walk the sea floor wearing a helmet with air supplied from the surface. No diving experience needed.

items.name: Parasailing
items.description: See the island and reef flat from the air.

items.name: Kayaks & beach hire
items.description: Towels, umbrellas, sun lounges and non-motorised water sports. Motorised water sports are not allowed.

items.name: GoPro hire
items.description: Record your snorkel or dive in high definition.

items.name: Boardwalk eco walk
items.description: 1.3 km return through the rainforest to the southern lookout. Allow 30 to 50 minutes. This app is your guide.

items.name: Beach walk
items.description: 1.5 km circuit around the whole island. Allow 45 minutes to an hour. Do not attempt at high tide.

items.name: Jetty walk
items.description: Walk the 250 m jetty for turtles, rays and the postcard view back to the island.

items.name: Marineland Melanesia
items.description: Crocodile habitat and Melanesian artefacts, operating since 1964 as a crocodile farm and renamed in 1972.

items.name: Scenic helicopter flight
items.description: A short flight over Green Island and the reef.

items.name: Swimming pool
items.description: Resort pool for day visitors on Eco Adventure and Discovery tours.

items.name: Lite Bites: The Cafe
items.description: Coffee, snacks and light meals near the jetty.
